About.hobbiesPart1: In my free time, I am committed to sustainability and enjoy vegan cooking and baking. I love being in nature—whether hiking in the mountains, road cycling, or bikepacking to discover new places and countries. Last year, for example, I cycled from Roth to Budapest and explored Denmark and Sweden.

Projects.title: My Projects
Projects.timeParabox: An interactive puzzle game with escape-box elements and a time travel theme, controlled via a native app.
Projects.bevry: A web app for cocktail enthusiasts to discover, share, rate, and manage drinks.
Projects.erika: An app that acts as a digital companion for climate-friendly actions and regional activities.
Projects.ecocalypse: Creation of an immersive video game scene in Unity with a focus on worldbuilding and visual storytelling.
Projects.veganAdvent: A digital advent calendar with valuable tips and information for a vegan lifestyle.
Projects.trilum: Analysis and redesign of the user interface of the wireless pick-by-light system TRILUM to enhance usability.
Projects.nakt: WordPress website without pre-made themes or plugins, focused on PHP development complemented by HTML, JavaScript, and CSS.

Experiences.title: My Career
Experiences.bachelorDescription: Bachelor thesis in collaboration with Fraunhofer: Analysis and redesign of the user interface of a pick-by-light system to improve usability using the TRILUM project as a case study.
Experiences.job1Description: Development with Vue.js; conducting and evaluating object measurements for a machine learning project; creating UI prototypes.
Experiences.job2Description: Developed a website to visually display customers' consumption, performance, and motion data using React and PHP. Worked full-time after my bachelor's (04/22 – 08/23) and part-time during my master's studies (09/23 – 02/25).
Experiences.masterDescription: Master's program in Interactive Technologies with a focus on Mobile.
